questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Español de America
- very interesting class where you learn a lot about the differences in the Spanish language in Latinoamérica, plus it's the best and sweetest professor.  

Lecturas contemporáneas hispanoamericanas
- very good class if you're into latinoamericano culture, literature and poetry 

El español y las lenguas del mundo hispánico
- interesting class if you want to learn more about Spain's different cultures and languages

Teatro y sociedad en los contextos iberoamericanos
- very good class if you're interested in Latin-American culture and theater, plus a very good professor as well.

What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Take good notes, you will need them for your finals 
2) Talk to the local students
3) Enjoy

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Passing my exams and assignments with good grades

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The finals. I had 5 exams in ten days, so it was very challenging having to study constantly, plus having to do assignments at the same time as well.
